card.name: Space before age ranges; 'for the' after 'not indicated'
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before an age number (e.g. 'aged', 'Children', 'patients') or right after 'not indicated for' / 'not approved for' in drug labels.

modes.label: Before age numbers
modes.description: The blank space after 'aged' or 'Children' just before an age such as 12 or 17.

modes.label: After 'not indicated for'
modes.description: The word 'the' or 'for' following a statement that the drug is not indicated or approved for a use.
